remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. On verso is an acid transfer of a drawing that is not by O'Keeffe. O'Keeffe wrote: "This is a drawing of something I never saw except in the drawing. When one begins to wander around in one's own thoughts and half–thoughts what one sees is often surprising" (*Some Memories of Drawings* [1988], unpaginated) (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A large, dark-colored blanket hangs across much of the upper portion of the image, with soft folds flowing off to the right. A second blanket comprised of alternating black and white horizontal stripes of various sizes descends from the upper-left corner across much of the lower portion of the drawing.  It lies in heavier folds than the darker blanket on its right.  A small patch of dark color is exposed in the lower-left portion of the drawing, forming a contrast to the striped blanket that it borders.
